_source.title: 获取当前 PCB 的详细属性
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前打开且拥有最后输入焦点的 PCB 的详细属性
_source.returns: PCB 的详细属性，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get detailed properties of Current PCB
remarks.text.0: It will get the detailed properties of the currently open PCB that has the last input focus
returns: PCB detailed properties of; if it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
